reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is org.owasp.esapi.ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML(new String(input)) written to response.getWriter(); HTML encoding is applied at the sink expression (line 108-112), neutralizing any XSS payload from the user-provided query string parameter that flows through bar/input. The data flow traces: getQueryString → param extraction → URLDecoder.decode → bar (trimmed) → input (as bytes) → new String(input) → encodeForHTML() → response output. Encoding mitigates the vulnerability.

evidence.note: Sink expression with encodeForHTML() protecting user input before HTML response output
